description: Land Acquisition - Divest the allotment in Thumbovila, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically concerns the divestment of a particular allotment of land (Lot No. 94) described in detail with boundaries, location, and extent. The content focuses on property/land transfer from the State, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. While a government minister is named, the core subject is land disposition rather than government personnel or organizational structure.
